events.text:
I built and deployed everything except the Zoom part: Live Control is live with the bot key set, but nothing has run in a real Zoom meeting yet. T-226 is blocked on the one input only Adi can give (T-335). The 5 poll scopes are also still missing from the Tantra Centre app, so creating polls in Zoom will fail until they are added.

**Done:**
- **Seat app:** the macOS app in `cloud/seat` builds with no errors or warnings. I tested it in a simulated meeting against a local centre, and all 32 checks passed on two runs (`app/scripts/probe-live-control.mjs`). Run sheet chat, call-to-action links and polls go out at their minute, and a later item does not go out early. With the room locked, an attendee who unmutes or starts video is turned off again. A listed co-host is promoted when the seat is host; as co-host it can't do that (only the host can), so it asks Adi in a private chat. Poll answers and chat land in `zoom_polls` and `zoom_chat`.
- **Live Control page:** a new Seat credentials card stores the SDK app's Client ID and Secret encrypted. The centre signs the seat's login token itself, so the secret never reaches the Mac.
- **Deploy:** I created a random `ZOOM_BOT_KEY`, applied migration 0019 to the live database, and deployed version 72a83733. Another lane had uncommitted work in `cloud/src`, so I deployed from a clean copy of my commit rather than the shared working folder. On the live site, `/bot/zoom/plan` returns 401 without the key and 200 with it. `/admin/control` shows no errors at desktop or phone width.
- **Auto-open:** the launchd job `com.tantra.live-control` is installed and has run once successfully. Every 5 minutes it asks the centre whether a session starts within 20 minutes, so time zone and clock changes can't make it miss one.
- **Push:** main is pushed to our private repo. That push also carried 47 earlier commits from other lanes that were sitting unpushed on main; the repo has no workflows that act on a push.

**Not done:**
- **Poll scopes:** this run had no browser signed in to Zoom, so the scopes are still missing. A later run with the browser tool needs to add them.
- **Zoom app code:** the file that talks to Zoom (`ZoomMeeting.swift`) is written from Zoom's macOS reference but not yet compiled against the real SDK, which needs the app from T-335. Expect some name fixes in that one file.
- **Today's session:** the seat can't join Day 3 today (Fri Oct 9, 11:00 ET) because the SDK app doesn't exist yet. Until the credentials are saved, the seat only writes a "built without the Zoom SDK" line to its log every 5 minutes during sessions, which does no harm.
- **What's left after T-335:** once the credentials are in, Claude downloads the SDK, builds the app and runs the test meeting for the done-when checks.

**Adi's one input (T-335):** create the Meeting SDK app "Tantra Live Control" at https://marketplace.zoom.us/develop/create (General App, Features, Embed, Meeting SDK on, do not publish). Then paste its Client ID and Client Secret into the Seat credentials card at https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/admin/control?v=t226seat (open the admin link first) and press Save.

Also in each session, Adi clicks "Make co-host" on the seat once in his Zoom app.
